title: Enterprise WebMCP
pitch: SaaS products have amazing UI but we forget where to click. Here's a framework to focus on the capability in the UI which can be multiple clicks to complete work in a single prompt

 Inspiration 

 SaaS products are beautiful but need seperate expertise to know what to click to get work done 

 What it does 

 Enables Capability Studio to create custom WebMCP functions on UI 

 How we built it 

 TypeScript and Python 

 Challenges we ran into 

 Creating WebMCP functions that are ad hoc and can change just like content in a CMS 

 Accomplishments that we're proud of 

 A CMS for WebMCP that can scale to any UI 

 What we learned 

 WebMCP have shorter context and more determinstic 

 What's next for Enterprise WebMCP 

 Scale to SaaS leaders like Salesforce or Hubspot

live_observation.first_impression: A polished enterprise work queue shows one access-approval item, navigation, persona controls, and a prominent governed-action button.
live_observation.after_state: A modal presented three governed workflows: request content access, prepare content, and prepare portal reuse, with explanatory safety text.
live_observation.notes: Central capability studio/governed action flow is visible, though the initial click opens choices rather than completing work.
